Your phone ran short of memory and closed OpenCode while it was setting up. Finished steps stay. Continue to pick up where it stopped.
Some phones close apps to save battery. Change these settings so the setup is not cut short.
Open the app's Battery setting and choose “Unrestricted” (some phones call it “No restrictions”).
Add OpenCode to Never sleeping apps.
